_comment: The `plan` field is the full workplan object — identical in shape to workplan.json. Inlined here so the event is self-contained; the frontend must not have to fetch the plan separately.

tasks.title: Opaque token issuance and revocable token store
tasks.description: POST /auth/login and /auth/logout. Random 256-bit opaque token, SHA-256 hash stored locally with user_id and expiry. Logout deletes the row (r2). No external IdP (r1).

tasks.title: Bearer-header auth middleware
tasks.description: Token from Authorization: Bearer, never a cookie (r5). Resolves via authenticate_user, attaches User to request, 401 on miss.

tasks.title: Scope note routes to the authenticated user
tasks.description: Apply middleware to /notes, filter every query by request.user.id. Existing tests get an auth fixture, not a rewrite (r3).

interface_contracts.name: authenticate_user
interface_contracts.notes: Single lookup point. None for unknown, expired, or revoked. The middleware never inspects token format, so storage can change without touching t2.

interface_contracts.name: tokens
interface_contracts.signature: tokens(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
interface_contracts.notes: Local SQLite, indexed on token_hash, so r6's sub-5ms budget holds on a single node.

concessions.accepted: Opaque tokens resolved against a local store
concessions.reason: r2 (immediate revocation) is a must-have for u1 and is unreachable with stateless JWT without a revocation list, which reintroduces the shared state r4 was avoiding.
r5 (no cookies on mobile) is a must-have for u2, and cookies were claude's preference rather than anything u1 stated.
